| 2026-04-26 | phase5 | **Phase 5.3: block_attn residual checkpoint fusion + doc sync** — (1) **`"attn_res_fused"` checkpointing mode** (`src/models/learning_model/learning_model.py`, `src/config/training.py`): new `selective_checkpointing_mode` option for `res_type="block_attn"` paths. Fuses ar() + sublayer + residual add into one `torch.utils.checkpoint` unit per sublayer so the ar() output (h_in) and the sublayer delta are both recomputed instead of retained, saving ~2×(B,T,D) per sublayer vs. `"full"`. `pb_prev` (old partial block sum, or a zeros sentinel on the first group sublayer) is passed as an explicit checkpoint input so gradients through `attn_res.queries` flow correctly; `block` and `sublayer_idx` are bound as default args at definition time to avoid Python loop-closure capture bugs. Falls back to `"full"` behaviour on standard and full_attn paths. (2) **Docstring** (`gradient_checkpointing_enable`): expanded to document all three modes and the `interval` parameter. (3) **Tests** (`tests/unit/test_learning_model.py`): added `test_attn_res_fused_matches_baseline_output_and_gradients` (forward + embedding + attn_res.queries gradient parity) and `test_attn_res_fused_with_interval` (interval=2 output equivalence); updated invalid-mode error-message assertion. | 2026-04-26 | phase5 | **Phase 5.3: chunked LM-head / cross-entropy training path** — (1) **`forward_hidden` extraction** (`src/models/learning_model/learning_model.py`): split `LearningModel.forward` so `forward_hidden(x, kv_caches=None)` returns post-final-norm hidden states `(B, T, d_model)` and `forward` is `lm_head(forward_hidden(x))`; behaviour unchanged for the standard path. (2) **Chunked CE primitive** (`src/training/loop.py`): added `compute_chunked_lm_loss(hidden, lm_head_weight, targets, label_smoothing, z_loss_weight, chunk_size)`. Splits along the time axis; each chunk's `(B, chunk_size, V)` logits are produced inside `torch.utils.checkpoint(use_reentrant=False)` so the full `(B, T, V)` tensor is never alive across forward and is recomputed once per chunk in backward. Mathematically equivalent to `compute_loss_with_smoothing(lm_head(hidden), targets, ...)`. (3) **Train-step wiring** (`src/training/loop.py`): `train_step` and `train` accept `use_chunked_loss: bool = False` and `loss_chunk_size: int = 256`. When enabled, `train_step` unwraps DDP/FSDP, calls `forward_hidden`, and runs `compute_chunked_lm_loss` against `lm_head.weight` (asserted `nn.Linear(bias=False)`). Eval path and existing default behaviour are unchanged. (4) **Config** (`src/config/training.py`): added `use_chunked_loss: bool = False` + `loss_chunk_size: int = 256` with `loss_chunk_size > 0` validation; threaded through `src/training/train.py`. (5) **Tests** (`tests/unit/test_training_loop.py`, new `TestChunkedLMHeadLoss`, 7 tests): equality vs full path with/without smoothing+Z-loss, hidden+weight gradient parity vs `lm_head(h)→CE`, chunk-size invariance (T, 4, 1), `chunk_size>0` validation, `train_step` parameter-update equivalence to default path on a real `LearningModel`, clear `AttributeError` when `forward_hidden` is missing. Same fix applied to MLA. (6) **Tests** (`tests/unit/test_kv_cache.py`, 22 tests): LayerKVCache init/update/overflow/reset/dtype; ModelKVCache length/getitem/reset; make_kv_cache structure; RoPE pos_offset shift; correctness — step-by-step cached generation matches full-sequence recompute for MHA, MLA, block_attn (atol=1e-4); all-positions, reset-reuse, prefill+generation variants.
